my-coach.title: Learning Coach
my-coach.purpose: Your next-best learning this month, ranked against your role and your target roles, with the reason for every suggestion.

coach-insights.title: Coach insights
coach-insights.purpose: Aggregated acceptance of Learning Coach suggestions. Counts only; groups under 10 people are suppressed.

my-coach-refresh.title: Knowledge refresher
my-coach-refresh.purpose: Five questions a day or a week from the open practice bank, spaced by how well you know them. Private, no scores.

training-refreshers.title: Refresher item difficulty
training-refreshers.purpose: How hard each practice question is in real refresher use, as aggregates only (suppressed under 10 people).

learn-pathways.title: Future-skill pathways
learn-pathways.purpose: A pathway for every future skill and level: digital learning, applied practice and an assessment in one sequence, with a 3-6 month envelope, the weekly hours and how long colleagues took.

learn-pathway.title: Pathway
learn-pathway.purpose: One pathway with its steps resolved from the content that teaches the skill at this level today, and your progress.

my-pathways.title: My pathways
my-pathways.purpose: The pathways you follow, finished or left, your self-declared external completions and the pathways the Coach ranks for you.

training-pathways.title: Pathways and gap backlog
training-pathways.purpose: Edit future-skill pathways, see which steps no content teaches yet (the gap backlog) and coverage by area.

learn-external.title: External learning catalogue
learn-external.purpose: Curated resources from IAEA, World Nuclear University, OECD-NEA, universities and AI course providers, each admitted against published criteria.

training-external.title: External catalogue curation
training-external.purpose: Score external resources against the published criteria, publish only those that pass, and retire them with a reason.

coach.intro: Next-best learning for your role and your targets. Every suggestion says why it is here. Qualification is not a game: no points, streaks or rankings, and your choices stay private.
coach.noProfileBody: The coach needs a staff profile with a role. Sign in with a staff role card to see your suggestions.
coach.monthPinned: {n} pinned: expiring qualifications and mandatory items first
coach.monthHours: About {n} h of learning in this list
coach.monthKinds: {n} kinds of learning: courses, practice, on-the-job, people and reading
coach.feedIntro: Ranked by how much each item closes the gap to your current role (full weight) and your target roles (0.6). Open "Why this?" on any card to see the reasoning.
coach.feedEmptyBody: Your profile meets your role's requirements. Pick a focus role to plan ahead, or ask the coach about a topic.
coach.savedEmptyBody: Use Save on a suggestion to keep it here. Saving also tells the coach what you find useful.
coach.hiddenEmptyBody: Suggestions you mark as not relevant stay hidden for 90 days and appear here until then.
coach.privacyBody: Your goal, saved items and feedback are visible only to you. HR sees acceptance rates for groups of 10 or more people, never individual choices. Suggestions are computed by a deterministic engine from your own records; no exam items are used.

card.dismissHint: Hide for 90 days and show fewer suggestions like this
card.dismissedToast: Hidden for 90 days. The coach will show fewer suggestions like this.
card.enrolSession: You will be enrolled on {course}, session on {date}. Elective courses may need your manager's approval first.
card.enrolWaitlist: The session on {date} for {course} is full. You will join the waitlist and move up automatically when a seat frees.
card.enrolNoSession: You will request {course}. No session is scheduled yet, so the training team will offer you one.

goal.title: {n} h a week
goal.noneBody: Set a realistic number of learning hours a week if it helps you plan. It is optional.
goal.monthFit: This month's list is about {feed} h; your goal is about {month} h a month.
goal.private: Only you can see your goal.
goal.hoursHint: 0 to 40, in half hours. Leave empty or 0 for no goal.
goal.noStreaks: There are no streaks or reminders that punish a missed week. Training hours are tracked, not maximised.
goal.weekLoading: This week: reading your learning record…
goal.weekReached: You have reached this week's goal. Nothing more is needed for it.
goal.weekLeft: {hours} left, with {days} to go this week (Monday to Sunday).
goal.fitsTitle: Fits in the time left (required items first)
goal.recordedNote: Recorded hours come from your own learning record; some activities record no time.
goal.barsLabel: Recorded hours in the last {n} weeks

focus.currentWeight: Your current role counts in full; target roles count at 0.6.
focus.none: No target role yet. Pick up to three focus roles, or shortlist roles in the Career Navigator.
focus.drawerIntro: Pick up to three roles you are working towards. The coach adds their requirements at weight 0.6. Your development plan target and your shortlist are included automatically.
focus.securityNote: Security, safeguards and cyber roles show the career path only, so the coach does not plan gaps for them.
focus.futureNote: Goals you added in Future Me count like a target role.

ask.title: Ask the coach
ask.intro: Ask which courses, practice quizzes or training paths cover a topic. Answers come only from the course catalogue, the training paths and the FAQ, with a citation for each entry.
ask.label: Your question
ask.placeholder: For example: which courses cover chemistry for RO?

examples.radiation: Which course covers radiation protection basics?
examples.chemistry: Which courses cover chemistry for RO?

ask.answerCoursesRole: {n} catalogue entries cover this; entries marked "{role}" build competencies that role needs:
ask.none: I could not find a catalogue entry for "{q}". Try other words, or browse the catalogue.
ask.examRefused: The coach never shares exam questions or answers. Use the open practice quizzes to prepare.
ask.footer: Retrieval over the catalogue (BM25), no generated text. Durations and contents are as published in each entry.

reasons.expires: Your {qual} expires in {n} days: requalify before it lapses
reasons.refresher_course: {course} is the continuing training that keeps this qualification current
reasons.refresher_quals: Check the requalification requirements on your qualification card
reasons.must_keep: Mandatory for your role, due {date} (in {n} days)
reasons.must_keep_overdue: Mandatory for your role and overdue since {date}
reasons.waitlist: The session on {date} is full: {n} on the waitlist
reasons.no_session: No session scheduled yet: enrolling asks the training team for one
reasons.keep_sharp: Keeps {skill} sharp: core for your {role} role
reasons.practice_bank: {n} open practice questions, about {min} minutes. Practice bank only, never exam items
reasons.ojt_task: Task on the {standard} for {role}; evaluated by: {evaluator}
reasons.ojt_critical: Critical task: it must be performed without error to qualify
reasons.mentor_target: Mentor works as {role}, one of your target roles
reasons.reading_general: Operating-experience lesson every role can learn from
reasons.feedback_up: Ranked higher because you saved or enrolled on similar suggestions
reasons.feedback_down: Ranked lower because you marked similar suggestions not relevant
reasons.refresh_due: Due for review: last left in box {box} (due {date})
reasons.refresh_new: New to you: not practised yet
reasons.refresh_role: {skill} is a competency of your current role
reasons.refresh_requal: Your {qual} expires in {n} days: requalification is coming up
reasons.refresh_bank: From the open practice bank only, never exam items
reasons.agreed: Agreed in your career conversation on {date}

insights.intro: How staff respond to Learning Coach suggestions: saved, enrolled and marked not relevant. Counts only, from the coach's feedback records. No names and no individual choices.
insights.ruleBody: Any cell with fewer than {n} people shows "suppressed" instead of a value. Acceptance = (saved + enrolled) / (saved + enrolled + not relevant).
insights.acceptanceSub: Saved or enrolled, out of all feedback
insights.peopleSub: Distinct staff with at least one signal

refresh.intro: Short, spaced practice between continuing-training cycles. Questions you know come back less often; questions you miss come back sooner. Only you see your progress.

cadenceOpt.paused: Pause (no reminders on the coach page)

refresh.howBody: A correct answer moves a question up one box and it comes back later; a wrong answer sends it back to box 1, due tomorrow.
refresh.privateBody: Your answers and boxes are visible to you alone. Instructors only see how hard each question is across at least 10 people.
refresh.bankOnly: Questions come from the open practice bank, never from exams.
refresh.todayBody: {due} questions due for review, {fresh} not yet practised.
refresh.partial: You can check the questions you have answered; the others stay for next time.
refresh.summary: {n} of {total} correct. Each question is now scheduled for its next review.
refresh.nextDue: Your next review is due on {date}.
refresh.confidenceBody: How far up the {max} boxes the practice questions of each competency are. For your own planning only.
refresh.confidenceLine: {seen} of {items} questions practised · {mastered} in box 4 or 5
refresh.noGamesBody: There are no streaks, points, badges or rankings here. Qualification is not a game: refreshers only help you keep knowledge fresh.
refresh.teaserBody: Spaced practice from the open practice bank · {due} due for review

rstats.intro: How often practice-bank questions are answered correctly in knowledge refreshers. Aggregates only: an item or competency answered by fewer than 10 people is suppressed. Use it alongside item analysis in the item bank.
rstats.itemsBody: Share correct (p) across all refresher answers, beside the item bank’s own p-value when it has one.
rstats.privacyBody: Refresher answers are private to each person. This view counts people and answers only, and hides any cell with fewer than {n} people.

pw.peerLine: Colleagues took a median of {weeks} weeks ({n} completed)
pw.peerSuppressed: Colleagues' times are hidden until 10 people have completed this pathway
pw.pinnedHint: Chosen by the training manager for this step

problem.skill: Choose a future skill (not obsolete, never security).
problem.title: Give a title in English and Arabic (3-140 characters).
problem.steps: 3 to 8 steps, each with a kind, hours (up to 200) and EN/AR titles.
problem.sequence: Steps run learn, then practice, then assess, with at least one of each.
problem.over_envelope: The steps need more hours than the envelope and weekly hours allow.
problem.pins: Pins look like course:c-ai-gov (up to 6 per step).

cat.intro: Each future skill has a pathway at level 1, most at level 2: digital learning, applied practice and an assessment in one sequence. Steps pick up whatever teaches the skill at that level today; a step with nothing yet is "requested" and goes to the training gap backlog.
cat.noneBody: Sign in with a staff role card to see future-skill pathways.
cat.tileCovered: Future skills with an L1 pathway
cat.tileCoveredSub: Every future skill in the catalogue
cat.tileRequestedSub: No content teaches them yet; in the gap backlog
cat.picksIntro: Ranked against your 2030 role profile as well as today's, your goals and your weekly time.
cat.allIntro: Grouped by future-skills area. Open a level to see its steps.
cat.howBody: Learn, practise on real work (a gig, on-the-job task or placement), then show it in an assessment. Your progress comes from your own records: a passed course, a completed gig, an award. External completions you record yourself count, labelled "self-declared", and never become verified skill evidence.
cat.foot: Envelopes and weekly hours are planning figures set by Nuclear Training. Colleagues' times are medians of completed pathways and stay hidden under 10 completions.

det.intro: Steps resolve at run time from the courses, external resources, gigs and assessments that teach this skill at this level.
det.notFoundBody: It may be a draft, or you may not have access to internal learning content.
det.completeHint: Available when every step is done
det.tileTotalSub: Fits inside {cap} h of the envelope
det.progressBody: {done} of {total} steps done. Steps tick off from your records; nothing is typed in.
det.progressSelf: {n} step(s) done through self-declared external completions
det.stepsIntro: Learn, practise, then show it. Each step lists what teaches the skill at this level today.
det.requestedBody: No course, resource or gig teaches this at this level yet. The step is in the training gap backlog; it fills itself when content appears.
det.peersBody: Median weeks from start to completion, shown only when 10 or more people have completed.
det.externalBody: come from the curated catalogue. Your completion is recorded as self-declared until verified.
det.startBody: Plan for about {hours} h a week over {months} months. You can follow up to three pathways at a time. Only you see your progress.
det.completeBody: Every step is done from your records. The completion is recorded and audited.
det.completeBodySelf: Every step is done; {n} of them through self-declared external completions, which stay labelled and do not count as verified evidence.
det.leaveBody: Your records stay. You can follow it again later.

my.intro: Your pathways and what is left to do, worked out from your own records. Private to you.
my.none: Sign in to see your pathways
my.activeEmpty: You are not following a pathway
my.activeEmptyBody: Pick one from the catalogue or from the Coach picks below.
my.leftEmpty: You have not left any pathway
my.coachTitle: Pathways the Coach ranks for you
my.coachIntro: Against your 2030 role profile as well as today's, with the reason for each.
my.privacy: Your pathway progress and external completions are visible to you only. Others see only suppressed totals (10 people or more).
my.askDalil: Ask Dalil which pathway closes my gap

coach.intro2030: Pathways ranked against the skills your role needs in 2030 as well as today, your goals and your weekly time. Each card says why.
coach.introNow: Pathways ranked against your role today, your goals and your weekly time. Your role has no 2030 profile yet.
coach.empty: No pathway stands out for you right now
coach.emptyBody: You already hold the levels your 2030 and current profiles ask for, or you follow the pathways that would close them. Add a skill goal to see more.
coach.howBody: Rules, not a model: +3 when your 2030 profile names the skill at this level, +1.5 when a 2030 competency rises, +1 for today's role, +2 for your goals, +0.5 for emerging or growing skills, ±0.25 for your weekly time and requested steps. Only the next level you do not hold is suggested.

reasons.gap_2030: Your 2030 profile as {role} needs {skill} at level {level}; you hold level {have}
reasons.rising_2030: {skill} supports a competency your {role} profile raises by 2030
reasons.today_role: {skill} supports a competency your role as {role} needs today
reasons.my_goal: {skill} is one of your skill goals
reasons.next_level: You hold level {have}; this is level {level}
reasons.fits_goal: {hours} h a week fits your weekly goal of {goal} h
reasons.over_goal: {hours} h a week is more than your weekly goal of {goal} h
reasons.envelope: {months} months at about {hours} h a week
reasons.peers: Colleagues took a median of {weeks} weeks ({n} completed)
reasons.ext_external: External: completion is self-declared until verified

adm.intro: Edit pathways with the same checks as the server, follow the steps no content teaches yet, and see coverage by area.
adm.tileL1: Future skills with an L1 pathway
adm.tileEnrolSub: Totals shown from 10 people per pathway
adm.readOnlyBody: Only the training manager edits pathways and refreshes the gap backlog.
adm.gapsIntro: Steps of published pathways that nothing teaches at their level. New courses, resources or gigs with the skill and level close them automatically.
adm.gapsFoot: This backlog feeds the curriculum coverage scorer (FS57). A course teaches a skill when one of its objectives carries the skill and level.
adm.refreshBody: Every published pathway is resolved again; new gaps are added and filled ones are closed. Audited.
adm.coverageIntro: Share of pathway steps that resolve to at least one course, resource, gig or assessment.
adm.capacity: {total} h of steps; the envelope allows {cap} h
adm.autoHint: Steps also pick up anything that teaches the skill at this level.

xr.intro: Resources from outside ENEC that teach future skills. Each one cites its provider, a source and the date it was read, and is listed only because it met the published criteria below.
xr.listIntro: Provider, hours, cost band, languages, the skills taught and the date we last read the provider page.
xr.criteriaIntro: Published criteria, each scored 0-3. A resource is listed only when every required criterion reaches its minimum; the server refuses anything else.
xr.selfBody: When you record an external completion it is stored as an xAPI "experienced" statement, labelled self-declared. It can tick off a pathway step but never becomes verified skill evidence; verification of certificates comes later.
xr.recordNotice: This is recorded as self-declared. It counts toward your pathway steps, is labelled as self-declared, and is not verified skill evidence.
xr.selfDeclaredHint: Recorded by you; not verified evidence

problem.title: Title in English and Arabic
problem.url: https links to the resource and the provider
problem.as_of: A real as-of date, not in the future
problem.skills: 1 to 8 future skills at level 1-3 (never security)
problem.languages: At least one known language code

adm.intro: Score each resource 0-3 on the published criteria. Publishing is refused by the server unless every required criterion reaches its minimum.
adm.readOnlyBody: Only the training manager adds, publishes and retires external resources.
adm.publishBody: The server checks the published criteria again and refuses if a required criterion is below its minimum. Staff then see it in the catalogue and pathways.
adm.retireBody: It leaves the catalogue and pathways; it is never deleted.
adm.checkOk: Meets every required criterion: it can be published.
adm.draftNote: Saved as a draft. A published resource cannot be edited into failing the criteria.

wc.title: Close the gap: future-skills courses and pathways
wc.noCourses: No pack course teaches these skills yet.
wc.noPathways: Sign in as ENEC staff to see the pathways, or none is published yet.
